candidate.work: Foundry fixes a token's right-click handlers when it draws the token. The system installed its player right-click menu at 'ready', after the first map was drawn, so every token already on that map kept Foundry's owner-only right-click: the GM could right-click them, players could not, until the map was reloaded. The menu is now installed at 'init', and tokens already drawn are re-armed. Vehicles with a Street Life NPC at the wheel (not only moving traffic) offer Carjack.
